name: Dify
summary: Source-available platform for LLM apps and agent workflows: visual builder, RAG pipelines, model-agnostic. The Community Edition is free of a software fee to self-host, but you own the servers, updates and reliability.
best_for: technical teams that want to build and ship LLM apps and agents on a source-available platform they can self-host and control
skip_if: you want a no-maintenance, non-technical builder — a fully managed no-code AI tool saves you the infra and upkeep
honest_knock: 'Free' self-hosting isn't free — you own the servers, updates and reliability, and model usage bills separately once the included message credits run out. Dify Cloud takes that infrastructure work off your hands, but every cloud plan is a single workspace, and multiple workspaces, SSO and a commercial licence sit in quote-only Enterprise. It's powerful, but self-hosting it well needs technical comfort.

pricing.notes: Source-available and free of a software fee to self-host — the Community Edition ships under the Dify Open Source License, a modified Apache 2.0 with additional conditions — while the managed Dify Cloud adds a free Sandbox, Professional at $59/mo ($590/yr) and Team at $159/mo ($1,590/yr), each priced per workspace (2026). Self-hosting still costs you infrastructure, model usage and any commercial licence those terms require. Cloud plans include message credits for supported model providers; once those run out you connect your own provider API key and pay that provider directly.
